segments.text: Then Job answered,
“No doubt, but you are the people, and wisdom will die with you.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: Yes, who doesn’t know such things as these?
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: I am like one who is a joke to his neighbor, I, who called on God, and he answered.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: The just, the blameless man is a joke.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: In the thought of him who is at ease there is contempt for misfortune. It is ready for them whose foot slips.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: The tents of robbers prosper. Those who provoke God are secure,
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: who carry their god in their hands.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: “But ask the animals now, and they will teach you; the birds of the sky, and they will tell you.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: Or speak to the earth, and it will teach you. The fish of the sea will declare to you.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: Who doesn’t know that in all these, Yahweh’s hand has done this,
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: in whose hand is the life of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind?
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: Doesn’t the ear try words, even as the palate tastes its food?
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: With aged men is wisdom, in length of days understanding.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: “With God is wisdom and might. He has counsel and understanding.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: Behold, he breaks down, and it can’t be built again. He imprisons a man, and there can be no release.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: Behold, he withholds the waters, and they dry up. Again, he sends them out, and they overturn the earth.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: With him is strength and wisdom. The deceived and the deceiver are his.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: He leads counselors away stripped. He makes judges fools.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: He loosens the bond of kings. He binds their waist with a belt.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: He leads priests away stripped, and overthrows the mighty.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: He removes the speech of those who are trusted, and takes away the understanding of the elders.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: He pours contempt on princes, and loosens the belt of the strong.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: He uncovers deep things out of darkness, and brings out to light the shadow of death.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: He increases the nations, and he destroys them. He enlarges the nations, and he leads them captive.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: He takes away understanding from the chiefs of the people of the earth, and causes them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: They grope in the dark without light. He makes them stagger like a drunken man.
segments.speaker: Job
